row.notes: Renames save directory param_2 (wchar) to param_3 (wchar), param_4 bool = create target first: logs 'Rename directory requested from %s to %s: %d', checks source with GetFileAttributesW, CreateDirectoryW retried up to ~16 times, MoveFileExW, maps errors (path not found / device full / corrupt) to Ne errors, logs 'Rename directory result: 0x%x'. Game_Save_UnmountSave calls it 3x at 0x14414ab50/0x14414ab73/0x14414ab94 to swap temp and live save folders (commit + rollback). Addon: the atomic commit point of a save; hook after it to back up the new save.
